This species of '''giant beetles''' was indigenous to the [[Unidentified planet (glass rain)|fourth planet]] of a remote system near [[Lasgo Port]]'s [[Unidentified planet (Lasgo Port)|planet]]. These giant beetles had red skin and were not known to attack any sentient beings. They mainly subsisted on glass during the planet's frequent "glass storms." Some of them were known to inhabit a ruined temple. Following her kidnapping, [[Ania Solo]] and her kidnapper [[Ramid]] encountered several of these creatures.
